drivers.driver: Buffett said Berkshire had not acted because nothing was sufficiently attractive; calls before Federal Reserve action did not offer appealing terms, and firms subsequently borrowed more cheaply in public markets.
drivers.quote: We have not done anything, because we don't see anything that attractive to do.
